text: *World of Warcraft: Forever* is live worldwide, a standing level 1–60 version of Azeroth that sits alongside modern and Classic WoW.
The first raids open on December 9, 2026: the 10-player Barrow Deeps, the 20-player Hyjal Summit, and the 40-player Onyxia’s Lair.
A November 11 hotfix treats Paladin Judgement as a ranged attack, so it uses ranged hit chance and no longer triggers melee item or effect procs.
A November 13 follow-up makes Judgement of Command a melee attack again, while other Judgements stay ranged.
The same November 13 notes say dungeon kills grant no experience to anyone in the party if the enemy is already trivial to one member.
Until raids open, a Blessed Band of Light can be traded one way for a Channeler's Ring at Pix Xizzix, after a November 13 item adjustment.
